name: send-delivery-uncertain
description: The recipient was offered the message once and did not answer in time. It may have been saved, so this is uncertain, never failed: do not resend under a new id as if it had failed. A late ack or report corrects the gateway's record, and GET /messages/{id} shows the correction. A client that meets a result it does not know treats it as uncertain.

body.detail: the recipient did not answer in time; the message may have been saved
